|lore=Renowned female psychic. Predictor of doom. Agent for Governor Aryon of Tatooine. Tailed Jabba and his thugs to Docking Bay 94 when they confronted Han Solo.

|notes=This is the numbered black-on-white presentation of Prophetess (V). The Players Committee distributed it as Virtual Set #1 through Decipher. Both numbered PDFs record creation on 6 March 2002 and state tournament legality from 9 March. The numbered sheets print collector mark 1•8 with identical words and game values in the two ink layouts. The 2006 wording expressly identifies the chosen opponent’s deck or pile as the object of the optional shuffle. Other editions include [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Original unnumbered)|Original (unnumbered)]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Numbered white-on-black)|Numbered (white-on-black)]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Premium)|Premium]], [[Prophetess (V) (Virtual Set 1: Legacy) (Remastered 2006)|Remastered (2006)]].
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf#page=1 VirtualCards1.pdf] — the Virtual Set #1 sheet hosted by Decipher (PDF made 6 March 2002; tournament-legal 9 March 2002); page 1, slip 8. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Same cards on the 5 March 2002 sheet: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf] (res.starwarsccg.org).
